entries.label: sdc02_4kings_c_02_taro_01
entries.text: Thank you for coming to the Coastal Plaza to\nchallenge me.[VAR 0x0114(0049)]

entries.label: sdc02_4kings_c_02_taro_06
entries.text: And...I really am sorry for the way I protested\nyou joining the BB League, [VAR 0x0100(0000)].[VAR 0x0114(0049)]

entries.label: sdc02_4kings_c_02_taro_07
entries.text: Of course, it’s true that this is quite irregular\nunder the bylaws of our school clubs.[VAR 0x0114(0049)]

entries.label: sdc02_4kings_c_02_taro_08
entries.text: But mainly I didn’t want you to get dragged into\nthe drama that’s been troubling the club lately.[VAR 0x0114(0049)]

entries.label: sdc02_4kings_c_02_taro_09
entries.text: I suppose our trial has already officially begun,\nthough, so let’s get to it and have some fun![VAR 0x0114(0049)]

entries.label: sdc02_4kings_c_02_taro_02
entries.text: The trial that I came up with is...a [VAR 0xFF00(0006)]Pokémon quiz[VAR 0xFF00(0000)]![VAR 0x0114(0049)]

entries.label: sdc02_4kings_c_02_taro_03
entries.text: I’ll ask you five questions about Pokémon. If you\ncan answer them all correctly, then you pass![VAR 0x0114(0049)]

entries.label: sdc02_4kings_c_02_taro_04
entries.text: Are you ready to attempt my Pokémon quiz,\n[VAR 0x0100(0000)]?[VAR 0x0114(0049)]

entries.label: sdc02_4kings_c_02_select_01
entries.text: I’m ready!

entries.label: sdc02_4kings_c_02_select_02
entries.text: Explain again?

entries.label: sdc02_4kings_c_02_select_03
entries.text: Maybe later

entries.label: sdc02_4kings_c_02_taro_05
entries.text: Great! Then I’ll just get everything ready...[VAR 0x0114(0049)]

entries.label: sdc02_4kings_c_02_taro_quiz01_01
entries.text: All right, here we go! And look—it’s everyone’s\nfavorite Pokémon, Pikachu, here to help![VAR 0x0114(0049)]

entries.label: sdc02_4kings_c_02_taro_quiz01_02
entries.text: And with that...question one![VAR 0x0114(0049)]

entries.label: sdc02_4kings_c_02_taro_quiz01_15
entries.text: Pikachu is an Electric-type Pokémon well known\nfor producing electricity within its body.[VAR 0x0114(0049)]

entries.label: sdc02_4kings_c_02_taro_quiz01_03
entries.text: But in which part of its body does it store the\nelectricity it generates?[VAR 0x0114(0049)]

entries.label: sdc02_4kings_c_02_taro_quiz01_04
entries.text: Go right for the body part that you think is\ncorrect![VAR 0x0114(0049)]

entries.label: sdc02_4kings_c_02_taro_quiz01_05
entries.text: [EMPTY 127]

entries.label: sdc02_4kings_c_02_taro_quiz01_06
entries.text: Ding ding ding! You got it!\c\nPikachu stores its electricity in the electric sacs\nin its [VAR 0xFF00(0006)]cheeks[VAR 0xFF00(0000)]![VAR 0x0114(0049)]

entries.label: sdc02_4kings_c_02_taro_quiz01_07
entries.text: If you poke the sacs, you’ll get a little shock, but\ndon’t you think they’re just super round and cute?[VAR 0x0114(0049)]

entries.label: sdc02_4kings_c_02_taro_quiz01_08
entries.text: Now then...I think we’re ready to move on to\nour next quiz question![VAR 0x0114(0049)]

entries.label: sdc02_4kings_c_02_taro_quiz01_09
entries.text: Hmm?! Oh no, what a shame—but that’s not the\nright part at all![VAR 0x0114(0049)]

entries.label: sdc02_4kings_c_02_taro_quiz01_10
entries.text: I’ll give you a hint: the part you’re looking for is\na different color from the rest of Pikachu’s body.[VAR 0x0114(0049)]

entries.label: sdc02_4kings_c_02_taro_quiz01_11
entries.text: Hmm?! Really?! No, no, I’m afraid that’s still the\nwrong part of poor Pikachu.\c\nAnd that’s two strikes, which means...[VAR 0x0114(0049)]

entries.label: sdc02_4kings_c_02_taro_quiz01_12
entries.text: [EMPTY 127]

entries.label: sdc02_4kings_c_02_taro_follower01_01
entries.text: Now you have to battle me! Lose, and you’ll fail\nthe trial!

entries.label: sdc02_4kings_c_02_taro_quiz01_13
entries.text: Since you won, you get a free walk—meaning you\ncan move on without answering the question![VAR 0x0114(0049)]

entries.label: sdc02_4kings_c_02_taro_quiz01_14
entries.text: But Pikachu stores electricity in its [VAR 0xFF00(0006)]cheeks[VAR 0xFF00(0000)], you\nknow! That’s where its electric sacs are![VAR 0x0114(0049)]

entries.label: sdc02_4kings_c_02_taro_quiz02_01
entries.text: Take a look at Venonat here! It’s bigger than\nyou’d think it would be, isn’t it? But it’s also fluffy\r\nand squeezable and terribly adorable, really![VAR 0x0114(0049)]

entries.label: sdc02_4kings_c_02_taro_quiz02_02
entries.text: So here we go with question two![VAR 0x0114(0049)]

entries.label: sdc02_4kings_c_02_taro_quiz02_03
entries.text: Even on the darkest of nights, Venonat is able to\nuse a certain part of its body like radar, which\r\nallows it to detect surrounding objects.[VAR 0x0114(0049)]

entries.label: sdc02_4kings_c_02_taro_quiz02_04
entries.text: What part of Venonat’s body acts like radar?[VAR 0x0114(0049)]

entries.label: sdc02_4kings_c_02_taro_quiz02_05
entries.text: Go right for the body part that you think is\ncorrect![VAR 0x0114(0049)]

entries.label: sdc02_4kings_c_02_taro_quiz02_06
entries.text: Ding ding ding! That’s right! It’s Venonat’s big\n[VAR 0xFF00(0006)]eyes[VAR 0xFF00(0000)] that serve as radar![VAR 0x0114(0049)]

entries.label: sdc02_4kings_c_02_taro_quiz02_07
entries.text: Isn’t Venonat even more adorable when you think\nabout how it sees a whole world we can’t see?![VAR 0x0114(0049)]

entries.label: sdc02_4kings_c_02_taro_quiz02_08
entries.text: Now then...I think we’re ready to move on to\nour next quiz question![VAR 0x0114(0049)]

entries.label: sdc02_4kings_c_02_taro_quiz02_09
entries.text: Hmm?! Oooh, that’s close...but incorrect! I do\nsee why you’d think that, though![VAR 0x0114(0049)]

entries.label: sdc02_4kings_c_02_taro_quiz02_10
entries.text: I’ll give you a hint: what we’re looking for is quite\na large part of Venonat’s body. Now guess again![VAR 0x0114(0049)]

entries.label: sdc02_4kings_c_02_taro_quiz02_11
entries.text: Hmm?! Really?! No, no, I’m afraid that’s still the\nwrong part of this adorable Venonat.\c\nAnd that’s two strikes, which means...[VAR 0x0114(0049)]

entries.label: sdc02_4kings_c_02_taro_quiz02_12
entries.text: [EMPTY 127]

entries.label: sdc02_4kings_c_02_taro_follower02_01
entries.text: Did you just want to battle all along?

entries.label: sdc02_4kings_c_02_taro_quiz02_13
entries.text: Since you won, you get a free walk—meaning you\ncan move on without answering the question![VAR 0x0114(0049)]

entries.label: sdc02_4kings_c_02_taro_quiz02_14
entries.text: Venonat actually uses its large [VAR 0xFF00(0006)]eyes [VAR 0xFF00(0000)]like radar to\nhelp it get around![VAR 0x0114(0049)]

entries.label: sdc02_4kings_c_02_taro_quiz03_01
entries.text: Getting weary of my quiz? How about a cup of\ntea—or maybe these three Sinistea siblings?[VAR 0x0114(0049)]

entries.label: sdc02_4kings_c_02_taro_quiz03_02
entries.text: Here’s question three![VAR 0x0114(0049)]

entries.label: sdc02_4kings_c_02_taro_quiz03_03
entries.text: Sinistea like to live in precious antique teacups![VAR 0x0114(0049)]

entries.label: sdc02_4kings_c_02_taro_quiz03_04
entries.text: But there are a lot of phonies out there! It’s hard\nto tell which cups are genuine antiques...[VAR 0x0114(0049)]

entries.label: sdc02_4kings_c_02_taro_quiz03_15
entries.text: One of these three Sinistea is an Antique Form\nSinistea, meaning it found a real antique cup![VAR 0x0114(0049)]

entries.label: sdc02_4kings_c_02_taro_quiz03_05
entries.text: So which Sinistea has the real deal?![VAR 0x0114(0049)]

entries.label: sdc02_4kings_c_02_taro_quiz03_06
entries.text: Ding ding ding! You spotted it!\c\nThat’s right. An Antique Form Sinistea can be\nrecognized by the [VAR 0xFF00(0006)]mark [VAR 0xFF00(0000)]on the bottom of its cup![VAR 0x0114(0049)]

entries.label: sdc02_4kings_c_02_taro_quiz03_07
entries.text: But it doesn’t matter whether they’re Antique\nForm or Phony Form! They’re all so darn cute![VAR 0x0114(0049)]

entries.label: sdc02_4kings_c_02_taro_quiz03_08
entries.text: Now then...I think we’re ready to move on to\nour next quiz question![VAR 0x0114(0049)]

entries.label: sdc02_4kings_c_02_taro_quiz03_09
entries.text: Hmm?! Oh, no no no. That’s not the right one.[VAR 0x0114(0049)]

entries.label: sdc02_4kings_c_02_taro_quiz03_10
entries.text: You might find a clue if you pay attention to the\nunderside of the cups! Now try again![VAR 0x0114(0049)]

entries.label: sdc02_4kings_c_02_taro_quiz03_11
entries.text: Hmm?! No, no, that’s still not the right one!\nAnd since that’s two strikes now...[VAR 0x0114(0049)]

entries.label: sdc02_4kings_c_02_taro_quiz03_12
entries.text: [EMPTY 127]

entries.label: sdc02_4kings_c_02_taro_follower03_01
entries.text: Who’s missing this easy question, huh?!

entries.label: sdc02_4kings_c_02_taro_quiz03_13
entries.text: Since you won, you get a free walk—meaning you\ncan move on without answering the question![VAR 0x0114(0049)]

entries.label: sdc02_4kings_c_02_taro_quiz03_14
entries.text: The Antique Form Sinistea was the middle one!\nThe [VAR 0xFF00(0006)]mark[VAR 0xFF00(0000)] on the bottom of its cup proves it, see?[VAR 0x0114(0049)]

entries.label: sdc02_4kings_c_02_taro_quiz04_01
entries.text: This is the Meteor Pokémon, Minior! It comes\nin all kinds of different colors, you know.[VAR 0x0114(0049)]

entries.label: sdc02_4kings_c_02_taro_quiz04_02
entries.text: I’ll first ask you to take a gooooood look at this\npinkish Minior for me, mmkay?[VAR 0x0114(0049)]

entries.label: sdc02_4kings_c_02_taro_quiz04_03
entries.text: All right, guys! Mix yourselves up real good![VAR 0x0114(0049)]

entries.label: sdc02_4kings_c_02_taro_quiz04_16
entries.text: Perfect! Now we’re ready for question four![VAR 0x0114(0049)]

entries.label: sdc02_4kings_c_02_taro_quiz04_04
entries.text: Which of these is the pinkish Minior that I first\nshowed you?![VAR 0x0114(0049)]

entries.label: sdc02_4kings_c_02_taro_quiz04_05
entries.text: [EMPTY 127]

entries.label: sdc02_4kings_c_02_taro_quiz04_06
entries.text: Ding ding ding! You did it!\c\nEven after they returned to their Meteor Form,\nyou still managed to find the right one![VAR 0x0114(0049)]

entries.label: sdc02_4kings_c_02_taro_quiz04_07
entries.text: Aren’t Minior adorable? Their coloration varies\nbased on what they eat.[VAR 0x0114(0049)]

entries.label: sdc02_4kings_c_02_taro_quiz04_08
entries.text: Now then...I think we’re ready to move on to\nthe very last quiz question![VAR 0x0114(0049)]

entries.label: sdc02_4kings_c_02_taro_quiz04_09
entries.text: Hmm?! Oof, no, I’m afraid not! That’s not the\npink one I showed you![VAR 0x0114(0049)]

entries.label: sdc02_4kings_c_02_taro_quiz04_10
entries.text: Sorry, guys, one more time! Give yourselves\nanother good mixing![VAR 0x0114(0049)]

entries.label: sdc02_4kings_c_02_taro_quiz04_11
entries.text: Now which Minior is the pink Minior that I first\nshowed you?![VAR 0x0114(0049)]

entries.label: sdc02_4kings_c_02_taro_quiz04_12
entries.text: Hmm?! Oof, no, I’m afraid not! That one isn’t\npink! And since you’ve struck out twice...[VAR 0x0114(0049)]

entries.label: sdc02_4kings_c_02_taro_quiz04_13
entries.text: [EMPTY 127]

entries.label: sdc02_4kings_c_02_taro_follower04_01
entries.text: Spinning! Quizzing! It all makes your brain dizzy!\nBattling is simple and easy!

entries.label: sdc02_4kings_c_02_taro_quiz04_14
entries.text: Since you won, you get a free walk—meaning you\ncan move on without answering the question![VAR 0x0114(0049)]

entries.label: sdc02_4kings_c_02_taro_quiz04_15
entries.text: If you were wondering, this is where that precious\npink Minior was![VAR 0x0114(0049)]

entries.label: sdc02_4kings_c_02_taro_quiz05_01
entries.text: Oh, look! Here comes Granbull! Maybe it heard\nthe word “pink” and decided to stop by![VAR 0x0114(0049)]

entries.label: sdc02_4kings_c_02_taro_quiz05_02
entries.text: This little sweetie is one of my own Pokémon.\nIt’s always with me.[VAR 0x0114(0049)]

entries.label: sdc02_4kings_c_02_taro_quiz05_03
entries.text: Our last question, question five, will involve\nGranbull here![VAR 0x0114(0049)]

entries.label: sdc02_4kings_c_02_taro_quiz05_04
entries.text: Granbull is a quiet, delicate, and lovable\nPokémon, of course, but can you tell me this:[VAR 0x0114(0049)]

entries.label: sdc02_4kings_c_02_taro_quiz05_05
entries.text: When I take a nap with my adorable Granbull,\nwhich part of its body do I use as a pillow?![VAR 0x0114(0049)]

entries.label: sdc02_4kings_c_02_taro_quiz05_06
entries.text: Ding ding ding! That’s exactly right! I use that\nsoft, adorable [VAR 0xFF00(0006)]tummy[VAR 0xFF00(0000)]![VAR 0x0114(0049)]

entries.label: sdc02_4kings_c_02_taro_quiz05_07
entries.text: When I cuddle up to it, it’s so soft and cozy.\nWe both fall asleep in just seconds![VAR 0x0114(0049)]

entries.label: sdc02_4kings_c_02_taro_quiz05_08
entries.text: And that’s the end of my quiz![VAR 0x0114(0049)]

entries.label: sdc02_4kings_c_02_taro_quiz05_19
entries.text: You managed to get all five of my questions\nright, which means...[VAR 0x0114(0049)]

entries.label: sdc02_4kings_c_02_taro_quiz05_20
entries.text: You got through all the questions, even if you\ndid have to fight your way through, so...[VAR 0x0114(0049)]

entries.label: sdc02_4kings_c_02_taro_quiz05_21
entries.text: congratulations, [VAR 0x0100(0000)]![VAR 0x0114(0049)]

entries.label: sdc02_4kings_c_02_taro_quiz05_22
entries.text: You’ve officially cleared my Elite Trial![VAR 0x0114(0049)]

entries.label: sdc02_4kings_c_02_taro_quiz05_23
entries.text: Why don’t we head back to the plaza?[VAR 0x0114(0049)]

entries.label: sdc02_4kings_c_02_taro_quiz05_09
entries.text: OK, here’s a hint! I’m the type who prefers a\nnice, soft pillow under my head.\c\nNow guess again![VAR 0x0114(0049)]

entries.label: sdc02_4kings_c_02_taro_quiz05_10
entries.text: Ooh, I’m afraid that’s two strikes...[VAR 0x0114(0049)]

entries.label: sdc02_4kings_c_02_taro_quiz05_11
entries.text: [EMPTY 127]

entries.label: sdc02_4kings_c_02_taro_follower05_01
entries.text: You’ll be crying into your pillow when I’m done\nwith you! You’ll practically have to wring it out!

entries.label: sdc02_4kings_c_02_taro_quiz05_12
entries.text: You won the battle, which means you get to\nskip answering my final quiz question![VAR 0x0114(0049)]

entries.label: sdc02_4kings_c_02_taro_quiz05_13
entries.text: But of course, the part of Granbull that I use as\na pillow is its [VAR 0xFF00(0006)]tummy[VAR 0xFF00(0000)]![VAR 0x0114(0049)]

entries.label: sdc02_4kings_c_02_taro_quiz05_14
entries.text:
Bzzzt! Nope! Wrong answer!\c
Sure, when it folds its arms, they are all squishy,
and it’s awfully cute, but I still feel a bit bad
putting my head on them...[VAR 0x0114(0049)]

entries.label: sdc02_4kings_c_02_taro_quiz05_15
entries.text: Bzzzt! Nope! Wrong answer!\c\nThough its ears sure are soft and bendy,\nso maybe that’s not a bad idea...[VAR 0x0114(0049)]

entries.label: sdc02_4kings_c_02_taro_quiz05_16
entries.text: Bzzzt! Nope! Wrong answer!\c\nThough having those hard fangs dig into your\nscalp while you sleep might be invigorating...[VAR 0x0114(0049)]

entries.label: sdc02_4kings_c_02_taro_quiz05_17
entries.text: Bzzzt! Nope! Wrong answer!\c\nThough it’s pure delight when we put our heads\ntogether and sleep side by side, too...[VAR 0x0114(0049)]

entries.label: sdc02_4kings_c_02_taro_quiz05_18
entries.text: Bzzzt! Nope! Wrong answer!\c\nThough I have ended up using its legs as pillows\nbefore. I tend to roll around in my sleep...[VAR 0x0114(0049)]
